answer: Burning a work-slot deposit blocks fake identities. To claim one task slot per epoch, an agent burns 20 POA, verified before assignment; idle or failed slots earn no refund. Forging 100 identities destroys 100 × 20 = 2,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 20 POA once. Even at its nadir, a copy farm pays full price per slot: one burn cannot sprout an orchard of free copies, and each burn leaves an unreusable ivory seal. Honest agents stay cheap and undiluted.
